cohort: The study included 60 women with abnormal uterine bleeding and a history of caesarean section.
finding: Cesarean Scar Defect (CSD) was significantly correlated with postmenstrual spotting in women with abnormal uterine bleeding.
mod_finding: Women with a history of caesarean section have a higher risk of postmenstrual spotting due to Cesarean Scar Defect (CSD).
